function.description: Amend a live cron job in place: add to its task (append_text / prepend_text), change a passage (old_text -> new_text), or change its schedule, cap, rig, delivery or skills. Never cancel + re-schedule.
function.name: cronjob_edit

parameters.description: Amend a live job IN PLACE. Pass only the fields to change.

append_text.description: Text to ADD at the END of the task (no copy needed).

deliver.description: New delivery sink ('telegram'|'email' to the owner, 'twitter' = a PUBLIC X post), or 'none' to drop it.

exact_time.description: True: this job keeps its exact minute (see cronjob_schedule). False: it may move again.

expect.description: Replace what a run must do (see cronjob_schedule); {} clears it.

job_id.description: The id of the cron job to edit.

kb_holdout_pct.description: OWNER TURN ONLY: replace the job's KB holdout percent (see cronjob_schedule); 0 clears it.

new_text.description: Replacement for old_text ('' deletes the passage).

old_text.description: Exact passage of the current task to change or delete (from cronjob_show; must occur once).

pause_windows.description: Replace the job's pause windows ([[start, end], ...]); [] clears them.

precheck.description: Replace the job's $0 pre-check (see cronjob_schedule); {} clears it.

prepend_text.description: Text to ADD at the START of the task.

read_verb.description: Replace the job's read verb (see cronjob_schedule); {} clears it.

rig.description: New named tool rig, or 'none' to clear it.

schedule.description: New schedule spec (next run recomputed). To run once now, use cronjob_run_now.

script.description: Replace the job's script (see cronjob_schedule); {} clears it.

skills.description: Replace the pinned skill ids ([] clears them).

target_token.description: Replace the declared buy target {'chain', 'address'}; {} clears it.

tier.description: Optional model tier for this work's runs — from the owner's chat only: 'heavy' for work that decides money (who is paid and how much) or is hard to undo; 'light' for bulk reads; 'default' = the normal model. <environment> names each tier's model. Requires 'why'.

tools.description: New exact tool ids for this job's runs; [] clears them. A money tool needs a rig or the owner.

why.description: One line: why this tier. Required with 'tier'; shown in /status.

write_verb.description: OWNER TURN ONLY: replace the job's write verb (see cronjob_schedule); {} clears it.
